purpose: Use the full two-year daily history actually available from Massive to test weekly multi-month cross-asset momentum without modifying the blocked long-history protocol.

common_calendar.signal_date: last common trading date within each ISO Monday-Sunday week on which all eight ETFs have a valid adjusted close
common_calendar.entry_date: first common trading date after signal_date on which all eight ETFs have a valid adjusted open
common_calendar.exit_date: entry_date associated with the next weekly signal
common_calendar.lookbacks: Count only common trading dates on which all eight ETFs have valid closes.
common_calendar.missing_data: No interpolation, forward fill, proxy substitution or ticker substitution.

economics.cost_treatment: Every weekly leg pays the full round-trip haircut even when direction persists; no post-result turnover credit.

CA_TS63D_SIGN_WEEKLY_V1.signal: positive => long; negative => short; zero => flat
CA_TS63D_SIGN_WEEKLY_V1.portfolio: equal weight across all non-flat legs with gross exposure normalized to 1.0

CA_XS63_5_MOM_WEEKLY_V1.ranking: rank all eight ETFs by feature; ties broken ticker ascending
CA_XS63_5_MOM_WEEKLY_V1.portfolio: long top two and short bottom two, equal weight across four legs; gross exposure 1.0, net exposure 0

controls.reversed: Multiply every original direction by -1 using identical signals, rankings, entry and exit dates and identical costs.

gates.promotion: D0 only unlocks D3; D3 only unlocks D3b. Historical success never establishes persistent edge. Full historical survival creates a new candidate ID for prospective future shadow only.
